main_text.p: Grebelius hoc addidit distichon: Venit in Italiam, spectabilis indole rara, Germanus: rediit de puero mulier. Animus certè abhorreret, hæc sanctissimorum cœ-libum facta referre, nisi tam atrociter Dei filium in suis innocentissimis membris trucidarent.

Georgius Lilius, in Anglorum regum chroni-co, gloriatur Henricum septimum hanc adorasse Babylonicam bestiam, ac monstrum Sodomiticum, his verbis: Anno, inquit, Domini 1504. rex oratores tres, ad præstandam Iulio Secundo pontifici Rom. de more obedientiam, Romam mittit. Nec eo quicquam celebrius, opinione sua, inuenire in Anglorum historiis poterat, quo illum illustraret annum. Sed ita adulari norunt papistæ, ipsissimis Antichri-stis ac diaboli vicarijs, ut patriam, imò veritatem atq; Christum ipsum pro ventre prodant. Longè aliter egisse Coletum, apud Erasmum in vita ip-sius legimus, qui in concione ad regè dicebat, quòd Angli Christum potius agnoscerent principem, quàm aut Iulios aut Alexandros. Sed in supputatione vehementer Lilius errat: dum pro 23 regni sui anno 19. assumit, O perfidissimi gancones,po-tius Gomorrhiones. Ex Volaterrano & Tempo-rum sasciculo: Prædistus Iulius, anno Domini 1504 matronam quandam Romanam, nomine Fran-cis-

page.notes: Small marks in the margins, not text: a short dash in the left margin beside the lines "Venit" and "Germanus"; a dash in the right margin beside "Lilius"; "cc" in the right margin beside "Angli"; a small ornamental mark in the right margin beside "Fran-". Manuscript underlining of "Sodomiticum", "Coletum apud Erasmum" and "perfidissimi gancones, po-tius Gomorrhiones" is handwriting and was left out. Italic and roman passages were judged from the scan and may be inaccurate in the boundaries of the italic runs, especially in the lines from "Sed in supputatione" to "Tempo-rum". The printed "s" is transcribed as s, so "sasciculo" is given as "sasciculo". The verse distich is set in roman type and kept inside the first paragraph, which continues from the previous page.
